pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: Remove execution domain support All users of exec_domain are gone, now we can get rid of that abandoned feature. To not break existing userspace we keep a dummy /proc/execdomains file which will always contain "0-0 Linux [kernel]". Signed-off-by: Richard Weinberger <richard@nod.at> (cherry picked from commit 973f911f55a0e510dd6db8bbb29cd82ff138d3c0) BUG=b:80506651 TEST=ARC++ Change-Id: I588692a2e27cd21fe6e7da06a540c257cf50606c Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1735556 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Victor Hsieh <victorhsieh@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>

pd_faft: Perform standard DRP check if Try.SRC feature not supported The firmware_PDTrySrc checks the ratio of resulting SNK/SRC if Try.SRC is enabled or disabled. If the DUT doesn't support Try.SRC, we can still perform the test of Try.SRC disabled, to verify the standard DRP behavior. If Try.SRC not supported, the ratio of resulting SNK/SRC should be around 50%. BUG=b:138805927 TEST=Ran the firmware_PDTrySrc on two devices, one with Try.SRC supported, another with Try.SRC not supported, both passed. vm_tools: sommelier: Allow X windows to maximize on launch. The compositor "should respect" the the net_wm_state flags when mapping the window, which we were not doing up until now. This change adds that support. This works for more modern windows/toolkits which use net_wm_state but there is still an issue were legacy applications appear to take up the whole screen but are not maximized. power: Use backlight scale information if available Based on the number of brightness levels powerd treats a backlight as linear or non-linear. This seems to work in most cases, but isn't really a reliable heuristic. Newer kernels expose a 'scale' sysfs attribute, that may contain information about the scale of the brightness curve. Use that information if it is available, otherwise fall back to the old mechanism. BUG=b:135049060 TEST=on minnie: backlight changes are still (perceptually) linear, with and without 'brightness' table in the device tree Change-Id: I840c2815dbe6bd652d6822c1c1c96cf284a68cff Signed-off-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1789758 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Eric Caruso <ejcaruso@chromium.org>
